facts: Root settings classifies generation.mode=prebuilt as a canonical Root project and excludes it from generated includeBuild scanning.
The local runtime correctly adds :apps:backoffice only when the optional project exists.
The local runtime generated-domain scanner scans every cpf-*/cpf-domain.yaml with settings.gradle but has no prebuilt exclusion.
cpf-backoffice declares generation.mode=prebuilt, packageName=com.cpf.backoffice, and modules.online=true, so the scanner adds the unresolved duplicate com.cpf.backoffice:online dependency.
